Class ElementsStages

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.ElementsStages
@Internal public final class ElementsStages extends Object
Maps the stages of the streaming exchanges of the async clients without losing the elements: when the mapping fails, or the mapped stage was cancelled before the result arrived, the elements are closed, so that the connection is not reserved until the read timeout. Cancelling or externally failing the mapped stage cancels the stage it maps.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
